instruction: Can you use GIMP's native features to download the Columbia University logo in TIFF format from the internet, without opening Firefox, Chrome, or any other browser?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP is strictly an image manipulation program and lacks any web browsing or URL fetching functionality. It cannot access remote resources on its own.
